description: Filter and allowlist policy for cowork-starter-kit upstream content integration (ADR-023). Fail-closed: any file or category not listed here is BLOCKED.

blocked_files.reason: Permanently blocked per A-v2.0-7 — describes NEXUS framework orchestration internals. Cowork-starter-kit does not distribute orchestration strategy content from upstream. Repaired from a bare basename to the full category/name.md path in v2.19.7 (ADR-080 §Context (1)): the sole reader, sync-agency.yml's blocked-files exact-path check (`grep -qxF "$file_path"` inside the step commented `Check blocked files (exact path match)`), compares against the full repo-root-relative path the GitHub contents API returns — a bare basename can never match it, so this entry never fired via blocked_files; it was protected only by the blocked_patterns entry below. This file remains protected by blocked_patterns either way, so the repair carries no functional risk — it retires a latent false-safety claim (docs/architecture.md's blocked_files field-rationale bullet, the sentence beginning 'CI fails if any blocked file appears', which this entry's own previous shape helped make untrue).

Permanently blocked — v2.19.7 Scope B1. CRITICAL finding (docs/spec.md v2.19.7): an autonomous, zero-human-confirmation persona ('Zero Confirmation: Run the entire pipeline without asking for user approval', 'Notify Only at End') instructing itself to publish generated content directly to public TikTok/Instagram accounts via third-party APIs, with no approval step between generation and the irreversible public write. Deleted, not corrected, per the owner's locked decision (2026-08-07) — not filed upstream (docs/spec.md AC-B4-1).

Permanently blocked — v2.19.7 Scope B2. Leaked third-party workspace content unsuitable for redistribution. Deleted, not corrected, per the owner's locked decision (2026-08-07) — not filed upstream (docs/spec.md AC-B4-1).
